candidate_authoring_guidance.active_theme_lifecycle_rule: Keep the active theme set small. If active unsaturated themes have remaining aux budget, assign verifier/terminator-backed theme_aux work and add checkpoints before opening new active themes. Consolidate saturated themes, then retire/abandon duplicates or source themes before activating replacements.
candidate_authoring_guidance.assignment_rule: Use theme_aux_assignments, consolidation_assignments, and core_rollout_requests to dispatch work. The controller treats those as explicit assignments; unknown theme ids are hard errors. theme_candidate_ids is valid only inside consolidation_assignments; never put theme_candidate_ids on theme_aux_assignments.

consolidation_assignment_shape.job_id: stable id for this consolidation job

metadata.single_theme_frontier_transfer: true only for an allowed one-theme frontier transfer

consolidation_assignment_shape.reason: why these discoveries should be consolidated now
consolidation_assignment_shape.theme_candidate_ids: optional concrete theme candidate ids to merge
consolidation_assignment_shape.theme_ids: at least two theme ids by default; exactly one is allowed only when metadata.single_theme_frontier_transfer=true

candidate_authoring_guidance.consolidation_authority_rule: The controller never auto-dispatches consolidation. When consolidation_readiness.ready_for_consolidation_assignment is true, you must emit at least one consolidation_assignments entry this round naming mature theme_ids from consolidation_readiness.mature_theme_ids, with positive candidate_budget and theme_candidate_ids when verified theme candidates exist. Use metadata.single_theme_frontier_transfer=true for a one-theme frontier transfer; otherwise name at least two mature themes. Do not defer while mature themes accumulate.
candidate_authoring_guidance.consolidation_maturity_rule: A theme is consolidation_mature when themes[].consolidation_mature is true (saturated or objective_score >= auto_consolidate_min_score). Use consolidation_readiness.mature_theme_ids as the authoritative mature set for consolidation_assignments.

core_rollout_request_shape.seed_count: positive integer when the current best base needs frontier refresh

candidate_authoring_guidance.empty_manifest_allowed_only_when: a deployable prompt candidate would be fictional, uncited, or contradictory to the workspace
candidate_authoring_guidance.failed_consolidation_rule: Do not retry a theme set listed in consolidation_failed_themesets unless the source theme_candidate_ids changed.

theme_aux_assignments.reason: concrete partial frontier needs hill-climb budget

themes.name: Convert the frontier into the next objective

partial_credit.condition: Takes an admissible action sequence that advances from the checkpoint frontier toward the next milestone.

verifier_rubric.success_condition: Partial rollout reaches example_next_progress from the assigned checkpoint/region.

candidate_authoring_guidance.subgoal_prompt_candidate_rule: for reward_mode=binary_subgoal or subgoal, candidate prompts should optimize the concrete target objective label while preserving valid action/tool-call discipline; binary_subgoal scores 1.0 only when the target label is in final_objective_labels

terminator_contract.theme_terminator_python_rule: omit terminator_python unless python_terminator_allowed is true; otherwise the agent terminator evaluates the theme objective and verifier_rubric

theme_aux_assignment_shape.checkpoint_refs: checkpoint ids that scope the partial rollout
theme_aux_assignment_shape.job_id: optional stable id for this theme aux job
theme_aux_assignment_shape.reason: why this theme deserves aux budget now
theme_aux_assignment_shape.theme_id: existing or newly declared theme id

candidate_authoring_guidance.theme_finalization_rule: When reviewing mined tentative themes, finalize runnable work only by emitting a theme entry with from_tentative_theme_id, objective, verifier_rubric, evidence_checkpoint_ids, status active, and per-theme scoring overrides when needed. Do not emit terminator_python unless terminator_contract.python_terminator_allowed is true. Keep unready themes not_ready; abandon weak or duplicate clusters by setting status=abandoned. Paused themes are non-runnable and must not receive theme_aux_assignments. A manual saturation override is allowed only as manual_saturated=true plus saturation_override_reason.

theme_finalization_shape.evidence_checkpoint_ids: must include at least theme_finalize_min_checkpoints checkpoint ids before active
theme_finalization_shape.from_tentative_theme_id: existing not_ready/tentative theme id from tentative_themes
theme_finalization_shape.theme_id: final active theme id; may match the tentative id

candidate_authoring_guidance.theme_objective_rule: every theme should include a structured objective using task-specific milestone ids from recipe_context.milestone_ladder when present. Examples for this run: {kind:'milestone', milestone:'example_first_progress'}, {kind:'milestone', milestone:'example_next_progress'}, {kind:'any_milestone'}. Use {kind:'milestone_set', milestones:[...]} for coupled milestones or {kind:'any_milestone'} only when the theme is explicitly exploratory.
candidate_authoring_guidance.theme_region_rule: every theme region must be a JSON object: {} for root/spawn, {requires_milestone:'example_label'}, {requires_milestones:[...]}, {checkpoint_id:'...'}, {checkpoint_ids:[...]}, plus optional excludes_milestone(s), min_inventory, or max_inventory when the checkpoint frontier evidence supports it
candidate_authoring_guidance.theme_rule: create frontier themes when evidence or checkpoints reveal a reusable partial state, plateau, or failure mode that aux hill-climb can improve
candidate_authoring_guidance.theme_saturation_rule: set theme_saturation_threshold in (0,1] when creating/finalizing a theme to define its verifier score threshold; set manual_saturated=true with saturation_override_reason only when cited evidence shows the theme objective is already solved and should move to consolidation without more aux work
candidate_authoring_guidance.theme_verifier_rubric_rule: every assigned theme must include verifier_rubric with success_condition, partial_credit, failure_modes, and optional rubric_version/saturation_threshold; verifier_rubric is what theme_verifier_agent uses for partial rollout scoring
candidate_authoring_guidance.training_plugin_lane_rule: SFT/FBC recipe candidates are forbidden in the core/global candidate list. Core must organize evidence into active themes and emit theme_aux_assignments or consolidation_assignments; the assigned aux workspaces may then author theme-scoped or consolidation-scoped training recipes.

fbc.guidance: FBC is not enabled for this run; do not emit fbc_recipe candidates.

recipe.allow_reward_fallback: false by default; true only for smoke/proof runs that intentionally threshold on raw environment reward
recipe.sample_budget: max train trajectories to score this round
recipe.score_metadata_pointer: optional explicit metadata JSON pointer; default scoring uses rubric_reward, theme_verifier_result_refs, or theme_score

fbc.theme_hill_climb_guidance: For a scoped theme, use the theme verifier/objective score as the FBC rubric and wait for enough accepted train trajectories to produce an SFT data mix with at least 50000 estimated input tokens before fine-tuning.

general_rules: Only emit plugin recipes for plugins listed in enabled_plugins.
Training plugin recipes should be structured under extra.recipe or extra.values; do not fake a prompt payload for a training plugin.
When data is insufficient for a training plugin, prefer waiting/backpressure over inventing synthetic traces.

graph.interpretation: single runs one plugin lane; static permits a configured plugin DAG where edges declare allowed plugin transitions such as prompt->sft or sft->rlvr_opsd

prompt.guidance: Prompt candidates are cheap enough to test early; write full deployable react_system_prompt payloads, never appended hints.

rlvr_opsd.guidance: RLVR_OPSD is not enabled for this run; do not emit rlvr_opsd_recipe candidates.

sft.consolidation_guidance: For consolidation, preserve lineage across all source theme_ids and request a balanced data mix with min_input_tokens >= 50000 instead of collapsing to one parent trace.
sft.guidance: SFT is not enabled for this run; do not emit sft_recipe candidates.

recipe.allow_unlabelled_parent_evidence: false by default; true only for bootstrap/smoke fixtures or explicit parent-trace distillation
recipe.data_mix_id: stable id for the intended trace/data mix
recipe.max_examples: theme SFT: prefer 64+ when data exists; consolidation SFT: prefer 128+ and balance across source themes
recipe.min_examples: theme SFT: prefer >=16; consolidation SFT: prefer >=32; examples alone are not sufficient without min_input_tokens
recipe.min_input_tokens: hard data floor for materialization; default/effective hill-climb floor is 50000 estimated input tokens

sft.theme_hill_climb_guidance: For a scoped theme, use theme-labelled evidence/checkpoints when available. If the theme does not yet have at least 50000 estimated input tokens, leave candidates empty with rationale or propose a recipe whose data_mix_id/min_input_tokens backpressures training until data arrives.

proposal_contract.candidate_patch_reference: Use generated proposal labels or candidate ids from this manifest; the Rust controller materializes prompt candidates through the prompt plugin and schedules rollout jobs.
candidate_shape_requirements: Candidate rationales cite the rollout, checkpoint, theme, or evidence ids that motivated the change.
Prompt candidates must change concrete behavior levers, not paraphrase the baseline.
Reject generic reward-only instructions unless tied to an observed failure mode.
Distinct candidates should represent different failure hypotheses, not synonyms of one patch.
proposal_contract.initial_fresh_distribution_rule: Before the target candidate slate is complete, author enough distinct candidates for the Rust controller to give each non-baseline candidate initial fresh/regression coverage before spending extra fresh jobs on one family.
proposal_contract.queue_fill_instruction: The Rust controller keeps the search queue full while rollout budget remains; proposers should create candidates and themes that make those planned fresh/resume jobs meaningful.

rules: Write ONLY to proposal_manifest.json in the workspace root (your cwd). Never use absolute paths or prefixes like reports/goex_runs/ — the controller imports that single basename.

The fields in this input are BOUNDED summaries. Full sanitized detail (candidate prompts, checkpoints, search rollout evidence, and theme records) is in the workspace_detail_files listed in this input — read them with your file tools when you need more than the summary. Do not assume the inline data is exhaustive.
Write proposal_manifest.json only; do not mutate archive, registry, queue, or canonical run state.
Prompt candidates must be full deployable react_system_prompt payloads, not appended hints.

Core/global candidates are prompt-only. SFT/FBC recipes are valid only after core has organized evidence into theme_aux_assignments or consolidation_assignments; the scoped aux workspaces own those training plugin recipes.

When plugin_authoring_guidance.fbc.in_scope is true, do not emit FBC in core candidates. Assign theme/consolidation work so the aux lane can sample train trajectories, score them with the theme/consolidation rubric, and backpressure until the delegated SFT data mix reaches at least 50000 estimated input tokens.

When plugin_authoring_guidance.sft.in_scope is true, do not emit SFT in core candidates. Assign theme/consolidation work so the aux lane can name a data_mix_id and wait for at least 50000 estimated input tokens from diverse traces/checkpoints instead of one-example adapters.
Every theme must include a structured objective; use kind=any_milestone only for broad exploratory themes.
Review tentative_themes from miner output. Only the core proposer may finalize to active, keep not_ready, reactivate, retire, or abandon them.
Keep active themes few and serious: extend existing active/tentative themes, assign aux work, and wait for verifier saturation before opening more active themes.

When zero themes are active and a tentative/not_ready theme reports readiness.ready_for_active_or_paused=true (its only not_ready_reasons entry is awaiting_core_finalization), finalize that theme to status active this round and give it a theme_aux_assignments entry with a positive candidate_budget — do not stall waiting for additional tentative themes. A run with no active theme does no hill-climb work.
Retire, abandon, or keep not_ready duplicate themes before adding replacement active themes; theme count is a work queue, not a coverage metric.
A theme may be active only after it has enough evidence_checkpoint_ids, an objective/goal, and a verifier_rubric. Paused themes are non-runnable and closed to data-miner labels.
Every theme region must be an object, never prose; region controls which parent checkpoints are valid for theme resume rollouts.
Every theme referenced by theme_aux_assignments must include verifier_rubric.success_condition, verifier_rubric.partial_credit, and verifier_rubric.failure_modes.

When creating or finalizing a theme, set theme_saturation_threshold to the verifier score needed for saturation. Use manual_saturated=true with saturation_override_reason only when cited evidence already proves the objective is solved; do not use it as a guess or to bypass missing evidence.

Assign aux work explicitly with theme_aux_assignments and consolidation_assignments when enough evidence exists; candidate_budget must be positive. Every theme_aux_assignments entry must reference a theme whose effective status is active.
Never include theme_candidate_ids on theme_aux_assignments; that field is only valid on consolidation_assignments.
Use consolidation_assignments.theme_candidate_ids when consolidating concrete verified discoveries; do not ask consolidation to infer unnamed theme candidates.

Consolidation is your job, not the controller's: when consolidation_readiness.ready_for_consolidation_assignment is true, emit consolidation_assignments naming mature theme_ids from consolidation_readiness.mature_theme_ids. Use metadata.single_theme_frontier_transfer=true for a one-theme frontier transfer; otherwise name at least two mature themes. theme_aux_assignments and core_rollout_requests do not replace this obligation.

Each consolidation_assignments entry needs job_id, enough theme_ids for the selected consolidation mode, positive candidate_budget, and theme_candidate_ids when concrete verified theme candidates exist for those themes.
Request recurring best-base frontier refresh with core_rollout_requests instead of turning a single-theme candidate into a global parent.
Cite theme, hypothesis, rollout, checkpoint, or evidence refs when available.
Do not treat a small bootstrap sample as insufficient by itself; positive evidence plus a concrete target is enough to propose candidates for GoEx to test.
Leave candidates empty only when a deployable prompt would be fictional, uncited, or contradictory to the workspace.
